description: aree circolazione ciclabili is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Management of cycling areas. Longitudinal part of the road reserved for the circulation of cycles, carried out on its own premises, physically separated from other types of traffic, through suitable longitudinal traffic divides or in any case on a reserved lane, photointerpretable as intended for this specific function. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "cycling areas" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
